data.title: The network
data.lede: How a visit reaches this website.
data.intro: When you type the address, `Cloudflare`'s DNS answers. The zone is signed with `DNSSEC`, a signature that lets anyone check the answer was not altered on the way. The connection is encrypted with TLS 1.3 at the least, and in browsers that support it not even the site's name travels in the clear. On the other side there is no server of our own: a Worker answers, a program `Cloudflare` runs in the data centre closest to the visitor.

facts.text: DNS is authoritative on `Cloudflare`, and the zone is signed with [`DNSSEC`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/dns/dnssec/).

TLS 1.3 is the minimum version the zone accepts. [`Encrypted Client Hello`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ssl/edge-certificates/ech/) is on. Clients that support it also get the post-quantum key agreement `Cloudflare` offers by default.

[`Always Use HTTPS`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ssl/edge-certificates/additional-options/always-use-https/) redirects plain HTTP at the edge. The app sends HSTS with a one-year max-age, includeSubDomains and preload.

data.title: La caché
data.lede: Qué páginas se guardan ya hechas y cuándo se borran.
data.intro: Delante del Worker está la caché de `Cloudflare`, que guarda copias de las páginas en cada centro de datos. Si la página que pides ya está guardada, se entrega sin ejecutar el Worker. Solo se guardan las páginas que lo piden expresamente, y al publicar un cambio desde el gestor de contenidos (el CMS) se borran, por etiqueta, esa página y las que la incluyen en un listado.

facts.text: [`Workers Cache`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/cache/) está delante del Worker y es escalonada por defecto: un acierto no ejecuta el Worker.
Una página renderizada solo se guarda en el borde si lo pide. Cualquier otra respuesta renderizada sale con `no-store`.
Publicar una entrada purga, por etiqueta de caché, sus páginas y las que la listan. Menús y ajustes no se purgan: caducan antes de una hora.
Lo compilado bajo `/_astro/` lleva *hash* de contenido y se sirve con un año de max-age, immutable.
Las imágenes redimensionadas se guardan en la [`Cache API`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/runtime-apis/cache/).

data.title: The cache
data.lede: Which pages are kept ready-made, and when they are cleared.
data.intro: In front of the Worker sits `Cloudflare`'s cache, which keeps copies of pages in each data centre. If the page you ask for is already stored, it is delivered without running the Worker. Only pages that ask for it are stored, and publishing a change from the content management system (the CMS) clears, by tag, that page and every page that lists it.

facts.text: [`Workers Cache`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/cache/) sits in front of the Worker and is tiered by default: a hit does not run the Worker.
A rendered page is cached at the edge only if it opts in. Every other rendered response is sent `no-store`.
Publishing an entry purges, by cache tag, its own pages and the pages that list it. Menus and settings are not purged; they expire within the hour.
Build output under `/_astro/` is content-hashed and served with a one-year, immutable max-age.
Resized images are kept in the [`Cache API`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/runtime-apis/cache/).

data.title: Cómputo
data.lede: Dónde se ejecuta el código que genera cada página.
data.intro: Toda la web la genera un solo Worker con `Astro`, un *framework* que monta cada página en el momento en que se pide. Los ficheros que no cambian, como estilos, *scripts* e imágenes, se sirven directamente, sin ejecutar código. No hay ningún servidor detrás, y antes de responder el Worker añade siete cabeceras de seguridad a cada página.

facts.text: Un solo [`Worker`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/framework-guides/web-apps/astro/) renderiza las páginas bajo demanda con `Astro` (SSR). Los ficheros compilados se sirven como [`Workers Static Assets`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/static-assets/) sin ejecutarlo. No hay servidor detrás del Worker.
El equipo que hace `Astro` trabaja en `Cloudflare` desde enero de 2026. `Astro` sigue con licencia MIT y gobierno abierto.
Un *middleware* pone 7 cabeceras de seguridad en cada página que renderiza el Worker. La CSP no admite ningún *script* de terceros.
El Worker sabe la ciudad del visitante y qué centro de datos de `Cloudflare` respondió (`request.cf`). La apertura de seguridad en el borde los muestra.

Los *plugins* del CMS pueden ejecutarse en su propio [`Dynamic Worker`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/dynamic-workers/), sin red propia y con límites fijos de CPU, subpeticiones y tiempo. Todo lo que hacen pasa por un puente que comprueba las capacidades que declara cada uno.

data.title: Compute
data.lede: Where the code that builds each page runs.
data.intro: The whole site is produced by a single Worker with `Astro`, a framework that assembles each page at the moment it is requested. Files that never change, such as styles, scripts and images, are served directly, without running any code. There is no server behind it, and before answering the Worker adds seven security headers to every page.

facts.text: One [`Worker`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/framework-guides/web-apps/astro/) renders the pages on demand with `Astro` (SSR). The built files are served as [`Workers Static Assets`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/static-assets/) without running it. There is no server behind the Worker.
The team that makes `Astro` has worked at `Cloudflare` since January 2026. `Astro` remains MIT-licensed and openly governed.
One middleware stamps 7 security headers on every page the Worker renders. The CSP admits no third-party script.
The Worker knows the visitor's city and which `Cloudflare` data centre answered (`request.cf`). The edge-security opening shows them.

CMS plugins can run in their own [`Dynamic Worker`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/dynamic-workers/), with no network of their own and fixed CPU, subrequest and time limits. Everything they do passes through a bridge that checks the capabilities each one declares.

data.title: Datos
data.intro: Los textos y su historial viven en `D1`, la base de datos `SQLite` de `Cloudflare`. Las sesiones de quien edita se guardan en `Workers KV`, un almacén de pares clave y valor; `Images` recorta cada imagen a su hueco y la convierte a WebP, y `R2`, el almacenamiento de ficheros, queda listo para lo que se suba desde el CMS. La versión de pruebas y la de producción no comparten ninguno de los cuatro.

facts.text: [`D1`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/) (`SQLite`) guarda el contenido, sus revisiones y los ajustes. Cada petición abre una sesión de `D1`.
[`Workers KV`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/kv/) guarda las sesiones de los editores.
El Worker pasa cada imagen al *binding* de [`Images`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/images/optimization/binding/), que la ajusta a su hueco y la convierte a WebP.
[`R2`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/) está conectado como almacén de medios del CMS. Hoy cada imagen del sitio viaja con el código.
Preview y producción tienen cada una su `D1`, su `Workers KV` y su `R2`.

The photographs were restored locally with SeedVR2. FLUX.2 [dev] (Black Forest Labs) on [`Workers AI`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/flux-2-dev/) removed objects, extended frames and redrew from the photographs. Every prompt is in the repository.
The photographs are CC BY-SA, and the site credits them with the changes stated.

facts.text: The accessibility, engine, design, layout, copy, language and naming checks plant the defect they hunt, and must catch it before they report green.
Lighthouse in CI, against a local copy, takes the median of 3 runs on 9 pages: performance ≥95; accessibility, best practices and SEO, 100. All nine met it on 2026-10-16.
Accessibility: axe (WCAG 2.2 A+AA) and a keyboard pass on every route of the site, plus reflow at 320 px. Where text sits on a photograph, contrast is measured on the rendered pixels.
Each opening is checked mid-animation and at rest, in Safari's engine (iPhone and desktop profiles) and Chrome's (Pixel 7), with reduced motion too.
The rendered text of 30 routes is frozen. Changing a word fails until the new text is deliberately re-captured, so the change shows in the pull request's diff.
AI agents write most of the code under written rules, and the founder merges every pull request.
Every push is scanned for secrets, and a guard rejects any client name not published under References.
